command:
$root = (Get-Location).Path
$pyPath = python -c @"
import os, site
from pathlib import Path
root = os.getcwd()
u = site.getusersitepackages()
base = Path(u).parent
parts = [root, u]
for n in ('win32', 'win32/lib', 'pythonwin'):
    p = base / n
    if p.exists():
        parts.append(str(p))
print(os.pathsep.join(parts))
"@
$env:PYTHONPATH = $pyPath
$env:PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE = '1'
$env:PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD = '1'
Remove-Item Env:ANTHROPIC_API_KEY -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
$scratch = Join-Path $root '_scratch\az5g2'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $scratch, (Join-Path $scratch 'appdata'), (Join-Path $scratch 'output'), (Join-Path $scratch 'tmp'), (Join-Path $scratch 'measure') | Out-Null
$env:LOCALAPPDATA = Join-Path $scratch 'appdata'
$env:APPDATA = Join-Path $scratch 'appdata'
$env:TEMP = Join-Path $scratch 'tmp'
$env:TMP = $env:TEMP
$env:UOINK_OUTPUT_DIR = Join-Path $scratch 'output'
Write-Output "PYTHONPATH=$env:PYTHONPATH"
Write-Output "starting measure"
python -B scripts/measure_phase5_az5g2.py
Write-Output "measure_exit=$LASTEXITCODE"
description: Run AZ-5g2 measurement harness with disposable roots
